description: Run a tool find_tool named: one ({name, arguments}), or up to 25 ({calls: [...]}). Independent calls run at once; a failed call returns its own error. Read-only unless the paper-trading pack is on. Any argument can be {"$file": "path.csv", "column": "close"} (or "columns": [...] / "all") instead of pasted numbers. {"$result": i, "path": "close"} passes batch call i's output into a later call; every result also has a ref ("r1", ...) later calls pass the same way, {"$result": "r1", "path": "close"}, so data never needs copying.

as_of.description: As of this past date (YYYY-MM-DD): only what was public then.

calls.description: Several calls in one round trip; calls without $result run concurrently.

changes_only.description: Only what changed since this call last ran in this session.

digits.description: Round fractional numbers to this many significant figures (default 6; 4 saves tokens); whole numbers never change.

max_chars.description: Cap each result at this many JSON characters; the rest stays under its ref.

prove.description: Values to prove, as JSON Pointers into the calls' output (e.g. /0/result/sharpe): each comes with a proof against the signed receipt, for receipt_check.

receipt.description: Add input and output SHA-256 and pack versions, to recompute and compare later.

return.description: Batch: every result (default) or only the last.

select.description: Only these fields of each result, as dotted paths, e.g. ["verdict", "rows.0.accession"] (rows take column names).

view.description: Draw the result for the person (charts, statements, yield curves, backtests) where MCP Apps are drawn; you get a summary.

name: run_tool
title: Run tools
